Page2.Text1: Only the highest winner paid per winning combination.
Page2.Text2: REEL WAYS™ pays must occur on adjacent reels, beginning with the far-left reel.
Page2.Text3: All wins on multiple ways are added together.
Page2.Text5: The base game contains up to 243 ways to win.
Page2.Title: BASE GAME RULES

Page4.Text1: Only the highest winner paid per winning combination.
Page4.Text2: REEL WAYS™ pays must occur on adjacent reels, beginning with the far-left reel.
Page4.Text3: All wins on multiple ways are added together.
Page4.Text5: Free Spins contains up to 243 ways to win.
Page4.Title: FREE SPINS RULES

Page5.Text1: The MA symbol is wild and substitutes for all symbols except for the ELEMENT COIN symbols. In the base game, the symbol appears on reel 3, 4 and 5.
Page5.Text2: In the base game, wilds are persistent and move up 1 reel position for subsequent spins.
Page5.Text3: If a wild lands on an Element coin at the end of a spin that position becomes both a Wild and an element coin.
Page5.Text4: In Free Spins, the symbol appears on reels 2, 3, 4 and 5.
Page5.Title: WILDS

Page6.Text2: Each ELEMENT COIN that lands during the base game will fly into the corresponding colored bowl. Any ELEMENT COIN may trigger the corresponding bowl.
Page6.Text3: More than one bowl can be triggered on a single spin
Page6.Text4: If bowl/s are triggered the corresponding feature will start.
Page6.Title: ELEMENT COINS

Page7.Text2: The accumulation of ELEMENT COINS over time in the RED, GREEN and BLUE bowls has no effect on triggering the JACKPOT PICK feature or Free Spins.
Page7.Title: ELEMENT COINS

Page8.Text2: Any red ELEMENT COIN landing in the RED bowl may trigger the JACKPOT PICK feature.
Page8.Text3: 15 coins will be presented, coins are revealed by clicking on them. Coins will reveal FU BABY™ symbols or the UPGRADE symbol. Once 3 matching FU BABY™ symbols have been revealed, the corresponding JACKPOT is awarded.
Page8.Text4: If 3 UPGRADE symbols are revealed before a JACKPOT is awarded, the JACKPOT won is upgraded to the next level. If Grand is awarded, it will be awarded twice.
Page8.Text5: The feature ends when one jackpot is awarded to the player.
Page8.Title: JACKPOT PICK FEATURE

Page9.Title: COLLECTION BOWLS
Page9.Text2: MIGHTY: 6 Free Spins (3 to 6 WILDS added)
Page9.Text5: SUPER: 6 Free Spins (7 to 12 WILDS added)
Page9.Text6: ULTRA: 6 Free Spins (3 to 6 WILDS added) + JACKPOT
Page9.Text8: ULTIMATE: 6 Free Spins (7 to 12 WILDS added) + JACKPOT
Page9.Text3: MEGA: 6 Free Spins (5 to 8 WILDS added)
Page9.Text7: SUPREME: 6 Free Spins (5 to 8 WILDS added) + JACKPOT

Page10.Text2: ELEMENT COINS may also award the JACKPOT PICK feature.
Page10.Text3: Only RED ELEMENT COINS are available in Free Spins.
Page10.Text4: Free Spins will end when there are no Free Spins remaining.
Page10.Text5: Free Spins will end if the maximum win has been achieved.
Page10.Title: FREE SPINS FEATURE

Page11.Text2: During the base reel game, the red mystery envelope bonus may be triggered at random.
Page11.Text3: You will be shown a cash prize on top of the red envelope.
Page11.Text4: The win from this bonus is [REDENV_WIN] and is based on the current bet value.
Page11.Text5: After the prize is awarded, the game will continue as normal.
Page11.Title: RED MYSTERY ENVELOPE BONUS

Page12.Text1: Any combination of wins in a single game is limited and will not exceed [MAXWIN]. It may not be possible to reach this limit in a single game from every bet configuration.
Page12.Text2: In accordance with fair gaming practices, the outcome of each and every game is completely independent.
Page12.Text3: The chances of getting a particular outcome are always the same at the start of every game.
Page12.Text4: The expected return for this game is [RTP]. This reflects the theoretical return across many plays.
Page12.Text5: Malfunction voids all pays and plays. {versionNumber}
